title: Design a Hit Counter
description: Design a hit counter which counts the number of hits received in the past 5 minutes (300 seconds). Operations: `HIT timestamp` and `GET timestamp`.
input_format: First line contains integer `m`. Following `m` lines contain operations.
constraints:
1 <= m <= 10^4
Timestamps are in ascending order.
hints: Maintain a queue of hit timestamps.
On GET(t), remove all timestamps `<= t - 300` from the front of the queue.
The current length of the queue is the count of recent hits.
